title: Somewhat Disappointing
text: Somewhat Disappointing. I waited forever for this to get here so I could organize all my tea stash.  The product has proved disappointing on several levels. The compartments are a bit too small in width and length. A full box of 20 tea bags won't fit without stuffing them very tightly. Some packages like the Pukka teas are just a tad too wide for the space. I did figure out that if you put them in upside down you can get them in and out easier.  Having loaded it full I was not happy to find that it doesn't seal shut. Probably because the bags don't fit in there quite right and the lid doesn't have a latch of any kind. Poor design and execution.
